title: 3. Test explicit observation and gripper-action grounding
hypothesis: An explicit environment-derived observation/action contract prevents gripper-sign and coordinate-interpretation errors that otherwise make single-phase pick-place structures unsearchable.

prediction.rationale: Baseline is single-phase generation using the existing pick-place prompt assets unchanged. A 10-point confirmation gain would justify task-interface grounding before further search investment. Unlike D-013, this supplies interface semantics rather than restricting policy geometry or parameterisation.

falsified_by: The block-level paired 95% interval has an upper bound below +0.10. A zero-spanning interval is inconclusive; additional independent paired generations evaluated on fresh confirmation cases would resolve the success effect.
